title: Rabbi Menachem Deglaya
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In the Jerusalem Talmud, Berakhot ch. 4, halakha 4: Rabbi Pinhas, Rabbi Levi, Rabbi Yohanan in the name of Menahem Deglaya; and so it is in Midrash Tehillim ch. 104, Vayikra Rabbah end of ch. 26, and Pesikta de-Rabbi Kahana, at the historical folio locator 79b (and in Tanhuma Emor 19: Rabbi Menahem Deglil). It seems that he is the Tanna of the baraita mentioned in Tosefta Eruvin ch. 8, in the name of Rabbi Menahem ish Gelaya, who says: "A gutter in which thorns have grown," etc.

notes.text: Deglaya, Deglil and ish Gelaya are retained as distinct forms. Hyman’s equation with the Tosefta’s Tanna remains tentative.

The consulted Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 4:4 directly has the Menahem Deglaya transmission. The other name forms, the historical Pesikta locator and the proposed identification with the Tosefta’s Tanna remain Hyman’s account; the exact cited editions were not all directly inspected.
